name: Apollonius
description: Gathered the Gentiles and a great host out of Samaria to fight against Israel, and was slain by Judas, who took his sword

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Apollonius
cases.charge: Falling upon Jerusalem on the Sabbath under a pretence of peace; slaying a great multitude; taking women and children captive
